note: Illustration of the format only; not part of the reference result. The papers, quotes and numbers are real; retrieval_method is made up.

tasks.task_label: Detect a binary black hole merger signal in gravitational-wave strain data
tasks.fm_scope: gravitational-wave strain time series from a detector network
tasks.observable_or_target: presence of a compact binary coalescence signal and its significance (false alarm rate)
tasks.input_modality: calibrated strain time series of the LIGO detectors
tasks.setting: LIGO Hanford and Livingston, transient searches, binary black hole coalescence

papers.title: Observation of Gravitational Waves from a Binary Black Hole Merger
papers.match_rationale: Searches LIGO strain data for a binary black hole signal and reports its detection significance, the target of the task.
papers.evidence_text: The signal was observed with a matched-filter signal-to-noise ratio of 24 and a false alarm rate estimated to be less than 1 event per 203 000 years
papers.retrieval_method: lexical, query family: gravitational wave AND (detection OR observation)
papers.reported_result: SNR 24, false alarm rate < 1 per 203 000 years

tasks.task_label: Dijet transverse-momentum imbalance as a function of PbPb collision centrality
tasks.observable_or_target: dijet momentum imbalance distribution versus centrality
tasks.input_modality: reconstructed calorimeter jets (leading and subleading jet pT)
tasks.setting: PbPb collisions at sqrt(s_NN) = 2.76 TeV, CMS, jets above 120 GeV/c

papers.match_rationale: Measures the dijet momentum imbalance in PbPb collisions as a function of centrality, the target of the task.
papers.evidence_text: With increasing collision centrality, a striking imbalance in dijet transverse momentum is observed, consistent with jet quenching.
papers.retrieval_method: lexical, query family: (PbPb OR lead-lead) AND dijet AND (imbalance OR asymmetry)
